73:1.text: (i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

73:3.text: Half of it or a little less than that,

73:4.text: Or a little more. And recite the Qur’ân

73:5.text: Verily, We shall send down to you a weighty Word

73:6.text: is very hard and most potent and good for governing oneself, and most suitable for

73:7.text: Verily, there is for you by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties.

73:8.text: And remember the Name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with a complete devotion.

73:9.text: the Lord of the east and the west; Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)
. So take Him Alone as Wakîl

73:10.text: with what they say, and keep away from them in a good way.

73:11.text: And leave Me Alone to deal with the beliers
, those who are in possession of good things of life. And give them respite for a little while.

73:13.text: And a food that chokes, and a painful torment.

73:14.text: On the Day when the earth and the mountains will be in violent shake, and the mountains will be a heap of sand poured out.

73:15.text: Verily, We have sent to you
to be a witness over you, as We did send a Messenger

73:16.text: ; so We seized him with a severe punishment.

73:17.text: Then how can you avoid the punishment, if you disbelieve, on a Day
that will make the children grey-headed?

73:18.text: Whereon the heaven will be cleft asunder? His Promise is certainly to be accomplished.

73:19.text: Verily, this is an admonition: therefore whosoever will, let him take a Path to His Lord!
